entities.summary: Sven Anders Herman Danielsson is a Swedish government official who served as Director-General and Head of the Swedish Security Service from 2007 to 2012 and as Director-General of the Swedish Migration Board from 2012 to 2016. He served as Governor of Västra Götaland County from 2017 to 2021.
